cards.title: Full Stack Developer with BE Focus
cards.description: This role is for a true full-stack engineer, not just a frontend developer who connects to an API. The ideal candidate is backend-strong, confident on the frontend, and able to design and build systems from scratch.

vacancyDetails.roleDescription:
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer (Middle / Senior) to join our team on a part-time or full-time basis.

What we are looking for:
- Strong knowledge of both backend and frontend development
- Backend-first mindset, with the ability to work confidently on the frontend
- Solid architectural thinking
- Ability to design and build systems from scratch
- Experience in laying a strong foundation and planning for future extensibility
- Understanding of clean architecture, scalability, and maintainability

Requirements:
- React.js (4+ years), Next.js (2+ years), TypeScript (4+ years). Bonus if you know React Native.
- Supabase (1.5+ years) and GraphQL or REST APIs.
- PostgreSQL (3+ years) - strong knowledge beyond ORM level (queries, indexing, performance, data modeling).
- Bonus if you know Node.js, Nest.js, Express.js.
- Language requirements: Conversational English is required (B1). Ukrainian (B2) and Russian (B2).

If you enjoy building well-architected systems, thinking beyond just implementation, and owning features end-to-end, we’d be happy to talk.
